mapper.select:
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE AS title, CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, ADMIN_NAME AS adminName, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT ordered_notice.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT notice.NOTICE_ID, notice.TITLE, notice.CATEGORY_CODE, notice.VIEW_COUNT, admin.ADMIN_NAME, notice.CREATED_AT FROM NOTICE notice JOIN ADMIN admin ON admin.ADMIN_ID = notice.ADMIN_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND (notice.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR notice.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%')
AND notice.CATEGORY_CODE = #{search.categoryCode}
ORDER BY notice.CREATED_AT DESC, notice.NOTICE_ID DESC ) ordered_notice WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{search.page} * #{search.size}) ) WHERE RN > ((#{search.page} - 1) * #{search.size})

SELECT notice.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, notice.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, admin.ADMIN_NAME AS adminName, notice.TITLE AS title, notice.CONTENT AS content, notice.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, notice.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, notice.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM NOTICE notice JOIN ADMIN admin ON admin.ADMIN_ID = notice.ADMIN_ID WHERE notice.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( NOTICE_ID, ADMIN_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, CATEGORY_CODE, HIDDEN_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_NOTICE.NEXTVAL, #{adminId}, #{form.title}, #{form.content}, 0, #{form.categoryCode}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP )
